title: GPU-Direct Collective: Scalable Communication and Collective Operations on Modern GPUs
abstract: We present GPU-Direct Collective (GDC), a framework for scaling collective communication operations on GPU clusters. GDC leverages GPU-direct memory access and hardware offload to achieve near-linear scaling on thousands of GPUs.
tldr: Framework for scaling GPU collective operations

title: DistGNN: Distributed Graph Neural Network Training for Billion-Scale Graphs
abstract: We propose DistGNN, a distributed training system for large-scale GNN models. Our approach uses hierarchical sampling and graph partitioning to reduce communication overhead while maintaining convergence properties.
tldr: System for training GNNs on billion-scale graphs

title: Adaptive Loop Tiling for Heterogeneous Architectures
abstract: We present an adaptive loop tiling technique that automatically optimizes computational kernels for heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems. The technique uses runtime profiling to adjust tile sizes dynamically.
tldr: Dynamic loop tiling optimization for CPUs and GPUs

title: MPI-X: Unified Programming Model for Heterogeneous HPC Systems
abstract: MPI-X extends the MPI standard with unified abstractions for heterogeneous architectures. It provides transparent support for GPU acceleration while maintaining backward compatibility.

title: Exascale Storage I/O: Managing Data Movement at Scale
abstract: We analyze I/O patterns in exascale simulations and propose a hierarchical storage management system that optimizes data movement across memory levels.
